source: Real HTTP MCP and Spring Boot/MyBatis-Plus/MySQL; synthetic inputs only

checks.name: real MCP initialization, initialized notification and tools discovery complete
MCP transport rejects anonymous and forged credentials with HTTP 401
MCP Origin, Accept, method, JSON and protocol boundaries are enforced
survey search filters ownership before returning any records
statistics tool reads true version totals, valid/missing denominators and mean
cross-owner scopes, arbitrary owner arguments and unavailable versions are denied
keyword retrieval returns exact source text and separates matches from returned evidence
write tools, SQL arguments and out-of-range limits cannot execute
report tool excludes pending candidates and returns only fresh approved reports
a saved local plan executes through HTTP MCP and appears in owner history
plan and tool retries are idempotent and cannot overwrite question or arguments
other users cannot read conversations, plan in them or replay private turn IDs
actual configured model plans a read tool and authoritative results remain backend facts
unsupported write request remains a notice without invoking a write tool
read-only tool and dialogue operations do not alter original answer rows
new queries read changed data while earlier chat answers remain labelled snapshots
archiving a source hides stored answer text on subsequent history reads
default latest version and explicitly selected historical version never mix answers
